# Yardlet 0.11.2
## New
- Yardlet can be your default browser (System Settings › Desktop & Dock › Default web browser). A link you open in another app opens in a new tab beside the task you are looking at. Passkeys from iCloud Keychain don't work in it yet; security keys and passkeys on your phone (QR code) do. - Memory saver (Settings › General): tasks you haven't used in a while let go of their browser tabs and agent processes, and come back when you return to them. - Accounts you already have: add a Claude account folder, share everything but its login with the default folder, take an account off the list, or sign it out and delete it. Yardlet also finds account folders kept in other places. - Tasks follow your sign-ins in the built-in browser, a page an agent handed over included, and keep the sign-ins their agents make. - Find and connect servers from the MCP registries, Pipedream, Composio and Make, and bring in the MCP servers your other apps already use. - More connectors in the directory. They are new, so please open an issue if one doesn't connect. - Microsoft 365 (Outlook mail and calendar, OneDrive, Teams), with your own Microsoft Entra app for now. - Google Analytics and Google Ads, read only. - Zoom Meetings, Team Chat and Docs, read only, with your own Zoom app. - Twilio Docs: searches Twilio's public documentation. - Open a conversation image over the window, fitted, with zoom, the arrow keys and Esc. - Click any file in a conversation to open it: files outside the task's folders read-only, images and PDFs shown, folders in Finder. - A downloaded update shows **Restart to update** above the account button and in the menu bar menu. - Each agent starts on the newest CLI found on this Mac when you haven't picked one, and settings say when a newer one is elsewhere.
## Fixes
- A browser dialog or file chooser waits in its own tab instead of blocking the window, and shows when you go back to that tab. - An agent no longer takes over the tab you are using; it works in a tab of its own.
## Install
Download `Yardlet-0.11.2.dmg` below, or `brew install --cask zzunkie/tap/yardlet`. Earlier versions update themselves. Requires macOS 15 or later on Apple silicon.

# Yardlet 0.11.1
## Security
- An agent's browser now asks before opening a file outside the task's folders.
## New
- Apple connectors: Xcode through its own MCP bridge, App Store Connect with your API key, and the Mac's calendars, reminders and contacts. - The Google Drive connector reads what is inside Docs, Sheets and Slides, in parts for long files, and edits the ones Yardlet created or copied, asking before each change. It needs no new Google permissions. - Mercury in the connector directory, read only. - Bring a site's sign-in over from another browser into the built-in one: Chrome, Whale and other Chromium browsers, Comet, Opera GX, Yandex, Helium and Firefox. - An agent can hand a browser tab to you for a step only you can take, and wait for you. - The built-in browser reads and acts inside frames, those from other sites included, and can emulate a screen size per tab. - A child task or subagent can start on the account with the most room before its limits reset. - The review shows a Markdown change rendered, and the tasks that read or edited a file. - A task shows the servers its processes listen on, and opens one in the task's browser. - An agent can start a top-level task or one nested under another open task.
## Fixes
- Fix a crash when a task's side rail showed some tool calls. - The composer scrolls its text inside once it passes the field's lines. - A streaming conversation keeps following through a swipe toward its end. - The browser panel keeps its last frame while it resizes, and its tabs keep their titles while there is room. - Chromium's passkey and sign-in windows open over the tab that asked for them. - Tabs open past 16 across tasks, and a tab the browser could not open says why.
## Install
Download `Yardlet-0.11.1.dmg` below, or `brew install --cask zzunkie/tap/yardlet`. Yardlet 0.11.0 updates itself. Requires macOS 15 or later on Apple silicon.

# Yardlet 0.11.0
The first public release of Yardlet, a native macOS app for running coding agents. Codex, Claude Code and other agent CLIs open side by side in one window of projects and tasks, while each agent keeps its own agent loop, sign-in and session history.
This repository used to hold Yardlet's command-line predecessor, a Rust CLI. Its code and releases (v0.10.3 and earlier) stay available on the `legacy-cli` branch and its tags.
## Highlights
- One window for Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, Cursor Agent, Antigravity CLI, Kimi Code, Grok Build, Pi and others, each started with the CLI and account you already use. - Sessions stay in each agent's own store, so a task resumes in the original app or CLI and back. - Several accounts per provider, with each account's session and weekly limits. - Review the last turn's diff, restore or fork files, follow a pull request's checks through `gh`, and keep a terminal and files pane beside the conversation. - Connectors for every agent: Gmail, Google Calendar and Google Drive through Yardlet's built-in MCP server on your Mac, plus GitHub, Slack and remote MCP services. - A built-in Chromium browser the agents can drive while you watch. - Scheduled tasks, and session tools that let one task read, message or start another. - Updates through Sparkle from this release on.
## Install
Download `Yardlet-0.11.0.dmg` below, open it and drag Yardlet to Applications. It is signed with Developer ID and notarized by Apple. Requires macOS 15 or later on Apple silicon, and at least one agent CLI installed and signed in.
## Known limits
- Google connectors: Google is still reviewing Yardlet's access to Gmail, Calendar and Drive. Until it finishes, Google shows an "unverified app" warning when you connect an account, and the built-in Google app accepts a limited number of new accounts. You can use your own Google OAuth client in Settings > Connectors meanwhile. - The phone remote's Android app is not public yet.
